Name: Mestrônomo
Description: Music, ambience and soundboard for tabletop RPG game masters on Discord

Actions.Name: Scene
Actions.Tooltip: Switches to a scene (ambience + music) with a crossfade

Actions.Name: Play Sound
Actions.Tooltip: Plays a soundboard sound in the call (or only in your headphones)

Actions.Name: YouTube Play/Pause
Actions.Tooltip: Plays or pauses the YouTube queue

Actions.Name: YouTube Next
Actions.Tooltip: Skips to the next track in the queue

Actions.Name: Stop Effects
Actions.Tooltip: Stops every sound effect that is playing

Actions.Name: Call / Dismiss Bot
Actions.Tooltip: Brings the bot to your voice channel, or sends it away

Actions.Name: Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Raises or lowers a volume (music, effects, master...)

Actions.Name: Capture App
Actions.Tooltip: Starts or stops streaming the audio of an app

Open Mestrônomo to load the list.
Files in the sons/ folder of Mestrônomo.
